name: Carter (warm American host)
sounds_like: Mid male at 129 Hz, dark and warm (centroid 1155 Hz), talking fast - 6.5 onsets per second of speech, near the top of the library - but breaking for real breaths, including the longest single pause measured anywhere here at 1.15s. Casual American, swallowed word endings, 11-semitone swing that lifts into enthusiasm. 27.7s, the longest English reference available.
casts_well_as: Warm host, podcaster, friendly narrator, an everyman telling a story to friends, food or travel voiceover.
avoid_for: Formality, threat, ceremony, or clipped official diction. The register is loose and familiar and resists being made stiff.
note: Byte-identical to voices_examples/vibevoice/en-Carter_man.wav (same md5); either path renders the same voice. Length is a real advantage - 27.7s is in the 24-30s band the VibeVoice README recommends for cloning.
